## Module Endpoint Declarations

### `@bslt/identity` (82 endpoints)

<!-- <- main/modules/identity/contract/endpoints.ts -->

User identity, authentication, sessions, and API keys.

| Key                       | Method   | Path                                  | Auth     | Summary                                                                             |
| ------------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `register`                | `POST`   | `/api/auth/register`                  | `public` | Register a new user - sends verification email                                      |
| `login`                   | `POST`   | `/api/auth/login`                     | `public` | Login an existing user (returns 202 if 2FA challenge is required)                   |
| `refresh`                 | `POST`   | `/api/auth/refresh`                   | `public` | Refresh access token using refresh token cookie                                     |
| `logout`                  | `POST`   | `/api/auth/logout`                    | `public` | Logout and invalidate refresh token                                                 |
| `authStrategies`          | `GET`    | `/api/auth/strategies`                | `public` | Get enabled and disabled authentication strategies                                  |
| `verifyEmail`             | `POST`   | `/api/auth/verify-email`              | `public` | Verify email with a token - auto-logs in user                                       |
| `resendVerification`      | `POST`   | `/api/auth/resend-verification`       | `public` | Resend verification email to unverified user                                        |
| `forgotPassword`          | `POST`   | `/api/auth/forgot-password`           | `public` | Request password reset                                                              |
| `resetPassword`           | `POST`   | `/api/auth/reset-password`            | `public` | Reset password with token                                                           |
| `setPassword`             | `POST`   | `/api/auth/set-password`              | `user`   | Set password for first time (passwordless accounts)                                 |
| `magicLinkRequest`        | `POST`   | `/api/auth/magic-link/request`        | `public` | Request a magic link for passwordless login                                         |
| `magicLinkVerify`         | `POST`   | `/api/auth/magic-link/verify`         | `public` | Verify magic link token and login                                                   |
| `emailOtpRequest`         | `POST`   | `/api/auth/otp/request`               | `public` | Request a 6-digit security code for passwordless login                              |

| `completeOnboarding`      | `POST`   | `/api/auth/onboarding/complete`       | `user`   | Complete profile for a new passwordless user (name, username, password)             |
| `changeEmail`             | `POST`   | `/api/auth/change-email`              | `user`   | Initiate email change - sends verification to new email                             |
| `confirmEmailChange`      | `POST`   | `/api/auth/change-email/confirm`      | `public` | Confirm email change with verification token                                        |

| `createApiKey`            | `POST`   | `/api/api-keys/create`                | `user`   | Create an API key (the plaintext token is returned once)                            |
